 """Evaluation of small arithmetic formulas."""
 
 from collections.abc import Mapping
+import re
 
 
 class EvalError(ValueError):
     """The formula is malformed or cannot be evaluated."""
 
 
+_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"""
+    (?P<NUMBER>  \d+ (?: \. \d+)? )
+    | (?P<NAME>   [a-zA-Z_]\w* )
+    | (?P<OP>     [+\-*/%^] )
+    | (?P<LPAREN> \( )
+    | (?P<RPAREN> \) )
+    | (?P<COMMA>  , )
+    | (?P<SKIP>   \s+ )
+    | (?P<BAD>    . )
+""", re.VERBOSE)
+
+
+def _tokenize(formula: str):
+    for m in _TOKEN_RE.finditer(formula):
+        kind = m.lastgroup
+        if kind == "SKIP":
+            continue
+        if kind == "BAD":
+            raise EvalError(f"unexpected character {m.group()!r}")
+        yield kind, m.group()
+
+
+PREC = {"+": 10, "-": 10, "*": 20, "/": 20, "%": 20, "^": 30}
+UNARY_PREC = 25
+
+
+class _Stream:
+    def __init__(self, items):
+        self.items = items
+        self.pos = 0
+
+    def __iter__(self):
+        return self
+
+    def __next__(self):
+        if self.pos >= len(self.items):
+            raise StopIteration
+        item = self.items[self.pos]
+        self.pos += 1
+        return item
+
+    def push(self, item):
+        self.pos -= 1
+        self.items[self.pos] = item
+
+    def peek(self):
+        if self.pos >= len(self.items):
+            return None
+        return self.items[self.pos]
+
